title: Save Analysis Feature - Backend API Integration
description: Implement ability to save individual words and grammar points to backend API for external review

key_decisions: No local storage in extension (chrome.storage.local not used for saved items)
No UI for viewing/managing saved items in extension
Separate viewing application accesses saved data from backend

requirements.title: Save Individual Words
requirements.description: Users can save individual vocabulary entries with metadata to backend API
acceptance_criteria: Save button/control for each word in analysis
Saved word includes: surface (kanji/kana), reading, meaning, JLPT level, context sentence, source text, source URL
Visual confirmation when word is saved (success/error)
Error handling for network failures

requirements.title: Save Individual Grammar Points
requirements.description: Users can save individual grammar points with examples to backend API
acceptance_criteria: Save button/control for each grammar point
Saved grammar includes: pattern, explanation, examples, JLPT level, source text, source URL
Visual confirmation when grammar is saved (success/error)
Error handling for network failures

requirements.title: Save All Items
requirements.description: Users can save all words and grammar from current analysis with one action
acceptance_criteria: Save All button in prose-toolbar
Parses all words and grammar points from current analysis
Sends batch POST request to backend API
Shows count of items saved (e.g., 'Saved 7 items!')

requirements.title: Visual Feedback
requirements.description: Users receive clear visual feedback for save actions
acceptance_criteria: Loading state shown during save operation
Success confirmation with checkmark/icon
Error notification with retry option
Toast notifications for Save All action

requirements.title: Markdown Parsing
requirements.description: Extract structured data from markdown response for saving
acceptance_criteria: Parse Words section to extract individual word entries
Parse Grammar section to extract individual grammar entries
Extract kanji/reading from {kanji|reading} ruby format
Handle edge cases (missing sections, malformed data)

data_extraction.challenge: API returns markdown, not structured data
data_extraction.approach: Parse markdown to extract words/grammar items
data_extraction.ruby_format: {kanji|reading} needs to be parsed to extract surface and reading

inline_save_button.location: Next to each word/grammar item in prose
inline_save_button.success_state: Checkmark icon, green color, 'Saved!' (2s, then reverts)
inline_save_button.error_state: X icon, red color, 'Failed' (stays until clicked again)

save_all_button.location: In prose-toolbar, next to 'Save As' button
save_all_button.behavior: Shows count badge while saving (e.g., 'Saving 7 items...')

tasks.title: Implement Markdown Parsing Logic
tasks.description: Create functions to parse markdown response and extract structured word/grammar data
details: Handle edge cases (missing sections, malformed data)

tasks.title: Update API Service with Save Method
details: Return structured response (success, saved counts, errors)

tasks.title: Implement Save Functions in Sidepanel
tasks.description: Add saveWord, saveGrammar, and saveAll functions
details: Create saveAll() function that parses and saves all items

tasks.title: Add Checkbox to UI
tasks.description: Modify markdown rendering to include checkbox for each word/grammar item only
details: Add unique IDs to each word/grammar item for targeting items
Ensure checkboxes work with existing rendering

tasks.title: Add Save All Button to Toolbar
tasks.description: Add Save All button to prose-toolbar
details: Add Save All button HTML to prose-toolbar
Add styling for Save All button
Disable button when no content is loaded

tasks.title: Implement Visual Feedback System
tasks.description: Add loading states, success indicators, and error handling

tasks.title: Add Toast Notification Container and Styles
tasks.description: Add HTML and CSS for toast notifications
details: Add CSS for toast positioning and animations
Support multiple toast types (success, error, info)

tasks.title: Testing and Bug Fixes
tasks.description: Test all save functionality and fix bugs
details: Test error scenarios (network failure, API error)
Test edge cases (empty content, malformed markdown)
Test visual feedback in all states

day_1.description: Markdown parsing and API service setup

day_3.description: Visual feedback, testing, and bug fixes

risks.description: Markdown parsing fails on edge cases or API format changes
risks.mitigation: Comprehensive regex testing with sample API responses; fallback to save entire markdown if parsing fails

risks.description: Backend API not ready or endpoint differs from specification
risks.mitigation: Mock API for development; keep endpoint configurable in API service

risks.description: Network errors cause user frustration (items not saved)
risks.mitigation: Clear error messages with retry option; log failures for debugging

risks.description: Save buttons interfere with existing ruby tag rendering
risks.mitigation: Test save button placement carefully; use CSS to prevent layout issues

acceptance_criteria: User can save individual words with all required metadata
User can save individual grammar points with all required metadata
User can save all items from current analysis with one click
Visual feedback shown for all save actions (loading, success, error)
Toast notifications shown for Save All action
Network errors handled gracefully with retry option
Markdown parsing extracts words and grammar correctly
Save buttons integrate cleanly with existing UI
definition_of_done: Manual testing completed with sample API responses
Edge cases tested (empty content, malformed markdown, network errors)
API service updated with saveItems method
Visual feedback working for all save actions
out_of_scope: Viewing saved items in extension (handled by separate application)
Managing saved items (delete, edit) in extension
notes: This is a simplified scope compared to original requirements
No local storage means extension is stateless regarding saved items
Backend API is the source of truth for all saved data
Extension is purely a collection interface, not a management interface
Future consideration: Modify backend API to return structured data alongside markdown for more reliable parsing
